plan: An ice witch who roots several enemies and can protect herself by freezing herself.
aSurveiller: Her R (Frozen Tomb). On you, it stuns you; on herself, she becomes untouchable: save your damage for after.
contrer: When she freezes herself with her R, wait for it to end: she is untouchable.
Don't stick to her: her W roots around her.
Watch her claw (E): she can teleport to it.
forces: Can protect herself with her R.
faiblesses: Relies on her E to escape.

sorts.P: Champions who die near her become ice thralls.
sorts.R: Stuns a target or makes her untouchable.
